canonical_word_counts.derivation: sum of Stirling numbers S(P,k), k=1..4; recurrence S(P,k)=k*S(P-1,k)+S(P-1,k-1)

provenance_note: Checkpoint source hash records the snapshot at the beginning of this replay. The source classifier, generator, generated inputs, commands, and raw outputs are recorded separately. The weighted average derives from per-shard averages rounded by the C classifier and is not an exact total-state count.

replay_metadata.aggregation_policy: All 8 residues must appear once, with identical input hashes and global word counts. Verify each processed count equals the number of canonical ordinals with that residue. Sum event counters and processed, take minima/minima and maxima/maxima. Global words are not summed. Average uses rounded per-shard averages, so it is approximate within 0.05.
